can be accessed within the fourth tab in the bottom-middle of the screen. There are two quest types, the first being daily quests. Six of these appear every day. The second type are weekly quests. Four appear every week.

activate automatically without needing the player's input and can be pinned if the player wishes to do so. Additionally, the player can tap on a certain quest while in the dedicated quests menu to see a more detailed overview of the objectives that need to be completed to obtain its reward.

is a daily quest which requires triumphing any gamemode on any map with a specific chosen tower role or other tower type being the most placed tower. These can be cliff towers, spawner towers, offense towers, defense towers and support towers. The first refers to towers which can be placed on cliffs, which includes hybrid towers like the
, the second is towers which summon in units while the last three refer to the tower role displayed under their name in the inventory.

is a daily quest requiring the chosen tower to deal a set amount of damage. The requirement scales with the player's level, starting at 15,000 and going up to 50,000.
The reward for completing this quest is

is a daily quest comprised of two objectives, both requiring the use of a specific randomly selected tower from the player's inventory. The first is a damage requirement from a tower which scales based on the player's current level. The requirement can be as low as 20,000 damage and as high as 60,000 damage. The second objective simply requires a triumph on any mode or map with the tower.
The reward for completing this quest is

is a daily quest comprised of two objectives, where the first requires the player to defeat a set amount of enemies (any enemy). The number scales based on the player's level, being as low as 300 and going up to 500. Afterwards, the second objective is defeating a randomly chosen major boss that is accessible to the player.
The reward for completing this quest is
is a daily quest requiring the player to triumph within a team set of players. There are three variations of this quest - each requiring triumphing with two, three or four players.
The reward for completing this quest is

is a daily quest requiring the player to apply a set chosen status effect a varied number of times based on their level. The requirement can be as low as 60 and goes up to 120. The means include using status effect applying towers (like the

). The status effects effects are various limited time debuffs applied by towers like confusion (listed as Confuse), chill (listed as Frost), freeze, poison or shock. Status effects can appear even if the tower that applies it is not owned by the player, though thanks to consumables the quest will not be impossible to complete.
The reward for this quest is
is a daily quest requiring the player to triumph a map while having over a specific percentage of base health left. The requirement scales with levels, starting at 50% and going as high as 75%.
The reward for this quest is

is a daily quest that consists of one objective, where the player has to use a tower's abilities a certain number of times. This number scales with the player's level, starting at 10 and going up to 20.
The reward for completing this quest is
is a weekly quest which requires the player to triumph three random maps in any order.
The reward for completing this quest is
is a weekly quest with three objectives, each requiring a triumph in a randomly selected mode. These can be done in any order and be any mode accessible to the player.
is a weekly quest with only one objective, that being triumphing with three or less towers in your loadout.
The reward for completing it is

is a weekly quest which requires multiple triumphs where the base health is above a specific percentage, which scales with player's level. The needed triumphs go as low as 3 and go up to 5, while the health requirement can be as little as at least 50% of the base health and as high as at least 75% of the base health.
The reward for this quest is

is a weekly quest which requires you to do three, all of them with requirements meant to be done with a specific tower that scale based on player's level. The first objective is dealing damage with the tower, which can be anywhere from 200,000 to 500,000 damage. The second is a kill requirement, starting at 1,500 defeated enemies and going up to 2,500 defeated enemies. The last objective requires a number of triumphs, starting at 3 triumphs and increasing to 5 triumphs.
The reward for this quest is

is a weekly quest that focuses on economy management. It has two objectives, both that scale based on the player's level. The first is getting a total amount of cash, which can be gotten between multiple matches. It starts at 200,000 and with levels goes up to 500,000. The second objective requires triumphing while having at least a specific value of cash before the match ends. The number of triumphs can be as low as 2 and as high as 4, while the cash requirement can be anywhere from 10,000 to 30,000.
is a weekly quest that requires the player to kill two separate bosses.

is a weekly quest where the player has to use a support tower's ability a number of times and also triumph a few times with it. The requirements get increased with higher level counts. The first objective requires 50 to 100 ability uses of the tower while the second objective requires 2 to 3 triumphs with the tower.
